title: Create query, key, and value views
description: A quick reference for the three projection roles, feature widths, and independence constraints used here.

terms.definition: Three independent learned last-axis transformations that turn one hidden-state sequence into role-specific tensors while preserving batch and token coordinates.
The rank-three input containing one model-width feature vector at every batch and token position.
The input feature count consumed by each query, key, and value projection weight.
The output feature count produced by each projection for this one-head chapter.
The projected representation used later to ask what each token position should retrieve.
The projected representation used later to describe how each token position can be matched.
The projected representation carrying content that later attention weights will mix.
Attention in which one previous-layer sequence supplies the query, key, and value roles.
A learned matrix transformation that adds no bias vector after multiplication.
Separate query, key, and value parameters that let each role learn its own representation.
